summary: Iteration 50: Universal Minimization System Testing. Backend: 10/10 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Card minimize, Post minimize, Minimized tray, Type badges all working. Profile minimize and Reel minimize not testable due to data constraints (all posts from same user, no reels available).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 50 verified universal minimization system. Key findings: 1) Card minimize: Works via data-testid='card-minimize-btn' on ViewCardPage, uses addMinimizedCard (backward compat). 2) Post minimize: Works via data-testid='post-minimize-btn' in post dropdown menu. 3) Minimized tray: data-testid='minimized-items-tray' appears when scrolled down (minimized nav state). 4) Type badges: data-testid='item-badge-<type>' with colors - card uses CARD_TYPE_COLORS, profile=#8B5CF6, post=#3B82F6, reel=#EF4444, live=#EF4444+pulse. 5) Profile minimize: Button exists (data-testid='profile-minimize-btn') but not testable as all posts are from test user (redirects to my-profile). 6) Reel minimize: Button exists (data-testid='reel-minimize-btn') but not testable as no reels available. 7) Session storage key: 'bruno_min_items'. 8) Max 12 items limit enforced.

minimized_items_tray.details: Minimized items tray (data-testid=minimized-items-tray) renders when nav is in minimized state (after scrolling)

type_badges.details: Card badge (data-testid=item-badge-card) and Post badge (data-testid=item-badge-post) found in tray with correct colors

profile_minimize.details: Profile minimize button exists (data-testid=profile-minimize-btn) but all posts are from test user, so profile page redirects to my-profile

reel_minimize.details: Reel minimize button exists (data-testid=reel-minimize-btn) but no reels available to test
